sections.title: Section 1: Holiday Rentals
sections.html:
accommodation

(noun). phòng để ở, chỗ ở

We will provide accommodation for you.

wonder

(verb). muốn biết, tự hỏi

I wonder if you can help me.

property

(noun). tài sản

Be careful not to damage other people's property.

surround

(verb). bao quanh; bao vây

The lake is surrounded with trees.

field

(noun). cánh đồng

People were working on the fields.

annex

(noun). nhà phụ

Our rooms were in the annex.

feature

(noun). tính năng, nét đặc trưng

The phone has many features

woodland

(noun). vùng nhiều cây cối, vùng rừng

The house is in woodlands.

rural

(adjective). [thuộc] nông thôn

I live in a rural area

overlook

(verb). nhìn [từ vị trí cao] xuống, trông xuống

The place overlooks the whole city

spacious

(adjective). rộng rãi

The room is spacious

private

(adjective). riêng; tư; cá nhân

The hotel has private bathrooms.

narrow

(adjective). hẹp

I have a narrow bed.

sections.title: Section 2: Do-It-Yourself House Painting
sections.html:
improvement

(noun). sự cải thiện, quá trình cải thiện

I want to have some improvement in my IELTS band score.

interior

(adjective). bên trong

The interior design of the house has been changed.

decorate

(verb). trang trí

They decorated the room with flowers and balloons.

efficient

(adjective). hiệu quả

This is the most efficient way to do it.

untouched

(adjective). chưa động đến, chưa bàn đến

This place is left untouched

guesswork

(noun). sự phỏng đoán

I use the guesswork to estimate the price of the house

circumference

(noun). chu vi

You will be taught how to calculate the circumference

donate

(verb). hiến, quyên góp

She has been donating her blood for 2 years

leftover

(adjective). phần thừa, phần sót lại

We have to put the leftover carrot into the bin

furnishings

(noun). nội thất

We need to buy some new furnishings

coverage

(noun). mức che phủ, sự che phủ

He gets the coverage from his umbrella

odour

(noun). mùi

I don't like this odour

surface

(noun). bề mặt

This is the surface of the Moon

crack

(noun). vết nứt

I saw a crack on the wall.

patch

(noun). miếng vá

I'll have to sew a patch onto these jeans

plaster

(noun). vữa, thạch cao

He is repairing the wall with plaster

greasy

(adjective). dính mỡ

This pizza is too greasy.

dusty

(adjective). bám bụi

Such a dusty bike

ceiling

(noun). trần nhà

This is the ceiling

roller

(noun). đồ sơn tường, trần

He is using the roller to paint his house

brush

(noun). bàn chải, chổi sơn

I will buy this brush

bristle

(noun). lông cứng

The bristles are black

contaminate

(verb). làm ô bẩn

People are contaminating the water

lingering

(adjective). kéo dài

Durians have a lingering smell

rinse

(verb). rửa

Remember to rinse the fruits before you eat them

solution

(noun). dung dịch

We can make a solution by adding salt to water

soap

(noun). xà phòng

You can wash your hands with this soap

energy-efficient

(adjective). tiết kiệm năng lượng

The new light bulb is energy-efficient

tray

(noun). cái khay

She put the cookies on the tray

sections.title: Section 3: Benefits Of Student Work Placements
sections.html:
temporary

(adjective). tạm thời

The company needs temporary staff who will work for 6 months

placement

(noun). chuyến thực tập

The course includes a placement in Year 3.

vacancy

(noun). chỗ trống

There’s a vacancy in the accounting department.

apply

(verb). nộp đơn

He is applying for a job in this company

permanent

(adjective). vĩnh viễn, cố định

A tattoo is a permanent kind of body art

car manufacturing

(noun). nhà sản xuất/hãng sản xuất xe ô tô

Ford is a car manufacturing company

dull

(adjective). uể oải, buồn tẻ

He thinks that libraries are dull

psychometric test

(noun). bài kiểm tra tính cách

This question is in the psychometric test

fascinating

(adjective). quyến rũ, hấp dẫn, mê hồn

Your trip sounds absolutely fascinating.

renowned

(adjective). nổi tiếng

It is renowned as one of the region's best restaurants.

individual

(adjective). mang tính cá nhân

I need to finish the work as an individual not as a team

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

There are various types of fish

document

(noun). tài liệu

These are documents

prioritise

(verb). dành ưu tiên

You should make a list of all the jobs you have to do and prioritise them.

diagnostic

(adjective). chẩn đoán phát hiện

This is a diagnostic software used to find out the computer's illness

identify

(verb). nhận biết

You can easily identify him

car assembly process

(noun). quá trình lắp ráp xe ô tô

This is a car assembly process

material

(noun). vật liệu, tài liệu

These books could be materials for my essay

speed up

(verb). tăng tốc

It has to speed up to finish the race

employer

(noun). người tuyển việc

The employer complains about his work

technical

(adjective). thuộc kỹ thuật, chuyên môn

This is a technical drawing

initiative

(noun). sáng kiến

Look! He has a new initiative

evaluation

(noun). sự đánh giá, định giá

Evaluations of the new car will start at 9:00

impression

(noun). ấn tượng

The first impression of a person is very important

recommend

(verb). đề xuất, khuyến nghị

I recommend the food to you

accessible

(adjective). dễ hiểu

This place is accessible to the disabled

description

(noun). sự miêu tả, sự chỉ dẫn

She has given the police a full description of the thief

mention

(verb). đề cập tới

He mentioned that he was leaving his job.

nanotechnology

(noun). công nghệ nano

They use nanotechnology to produce the chips

evolution

(noun). sự phát triển, sự tiến hóa

The photo shows the evolution of the iPhone

publication

(noun). ấn bản

They're waiting for the publication of this book

out-of-date

(adjective). lỗi thời

This computer is out-of-date

edition

(noun). phiên bản

The dictionary is now in its second edition.

coverage

(noun). nội dung bao phủ

I prefer magazines with extensive coverage of diet and health topics

sections.title: Section 4: Researching The Origin Of Medieval Manuscripts
sections.html:
medieval

(adjective). mang tính chất của thời trung cổ

Alnwick is one of the medieval castles located in England, nowadays.

provenance

(noun). nơi khai sinh ra

Vietnam is the provenance of Phở

manuscript

(noun). bản viết tay, bản thảo

This is a manuscript

parchment

(noun). giấy da

This is a parchment

greasy

(adjective). dính mỡ

This pizza is too greasy.

court

(noun). tòa án

This is a court

calf

(noun). con non

A calf is following a cow

high-status

(adjective). thượng lưu, xếp hạng cao

She loves her high-status handbag

scribe

(noun). nhà thần học, người chép thuê

He is a scribe

barrel = vat

(noun). thùng lớn

This is a barrel

agitate

(verb). lắc, khuấy

He is agitating the barrel

bury

(verb). chôn xuống đất

She buried the treasure

slough off

(verb). tróc ra

My skin sloughs off

stretcher frame

(noun). hệ thống kéo dãn

This is a stretcher frame

uniform

(adjective). giống nhau, tương đồng

The shapes are uniform

bleach

(verb). làm mất màu

After being bleached, the color will change from light brown to white

desire

(verb). rất muốn, khao khát

They desire to learn new things

origin

(noun). nguồn gốc

It's a book about the origin of the universe

historian

(noun). nhà sử học

Ngô Sĩ Liên is a famous historian, he is the author of Đại Việt Sử Ký Toàn Thư

dialect

(noun). thổ ngữ, tiếng địa phương

This is an example of dialect

genetic

(adjective). thuộc về gen

Down syndrome is a genetic disorder.

baseline

(noun). cơ sở

Bravery is the baseline for learning how to swim

potential

(adjective). tiềm năng

Students are the potential customer of the banks in the future when they want to borrow money for going to the university

shed light on

(verb). giúp giải thích

The discovery of vaccine will shed light on finding the medicine for Covid 19

evolution

(noun). sự phát triển, sự tiến hóa

The photo shows the evolution of the iPhone

establish

(noun). xác minh

Bill Gates established Microsoft

trade route

(noun). tuyến đường thương mại

Silk road is the famous trade route, linking China and Roman Empire
